# rapidcsv

Vendored header-only dependency used to read terminal RCR and tabulated inflow
CSV files.

- Upstream: https://github.com/d99kris/rapidcsv
- Version: v9.07
- Commit: cbd8a0a937b249cc07e2db3bfa9cd2cc1689708f
- Files: `src/rapidcsv.h` copied unchanged as `rapidcsv.h`; upstream `LICENSE`
  copied unchanged as `LICENSE.md` (BSD 3-Clause).

Only the library implementation includes this header. It is a private build
dependency and is not required by installed-package consumers.
